LoyverseTokenCredential.title: Loyverse Personal Access Token
LoyverseTokenCredential.x-credential-instructions: Create a personal access token in Loyverse Back Office → Integrations → Access tokens. Paste the token only. Grant read access for the resources you use and write access for customer, category or supplier saves. Store reads verify access to your account; they do not verify write permissions.
